integrity: All embedded files contain full standalone content with measured UTF-8 bytes and SHA-256; a finite standard-library checker supplements an all-length proof. No external or independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The rational generating function is for q=3; general-alphabet result is a profile-realizability criterion only. Complete exact noiseless cyclic composition-read multiplicities are assumed. Indexing rotations does not increase the count of profiles. Possible unindexed equivalent prior results remain a risk.
title: Exact cyclic pair-composition capacity for ternary words with runs of length at most two
